SUAS-003 — System Boundary & Line Break Rules

The third SuperUnicode Architecture Standard: single-pass deterministic line breaking over 64-bit SUCS.

SUAS-003 (SBR) is the third SuperUnicode Architecture Standard. It defines where a line may, must, or must not be broken over the full 64-bit SUCS space (sucs_ex_char_t) via a single-pass deterministic state transition table (a UAX #14 analog) — no multi-pass buffer algorithm, zero allocation, O(1) pair resolution.

Break statuses

  • MUST_BREAK — a line boundary is mandatory (e.g. after a control).
  • CAN_BREAK — an allowed / opportunistic boundary.
  • NO_BREAK — a prohibited boundary.
  • ALPHANUM_BREAK — mandatory CJK/numeric alphabetic break.

Explicit SCP Break Markers

Codepoint Directive
0x00110020 SCP_BRK_MANDATORY — force a line break here
0x00110021 SCP_BRK_PROHIBITED — force no line break here
0x00110022 SCP_BRK_OPPORTUNISTIC — allow a break here

Zone dispatch

  1. Unicode Bridge 0x00000000–0x0010FFFF — curated UAX #14 break-class table + transition matrix.
  2. SCP 0x00110000–0x0011FFFF — Explicit Break Markers override; other controls are mandatory.
  3. Native SUCS 0x00120000–0x7FFFFFFE — O(1) high-bit range bitmask word test.
  4. ExtSUCS >0x7FFFFFFF — neutral gap default.
Feature Status
Four break statuses (MUST/CAN/NO/ALPHANUM) Yes
Single-pass O(1) transition-matrix pair resolution Yes
Zero heap allocation Yes
64-bit extSUCS zone dispatch Yes
Explicit SCP Break Markers override Yes
Invisible formatting (WJ, ZWSP) Yes
Native SUCS high-bit bitmask word test Yes
Alphanumeric (CJK numeric) break Yes
Tailoring override hook Yes

Reference implementation: include/suas/suas_sbr.h + src/suas/suas_sbr.c (freestanding C99, no heap), registered in suas_static.

Source of truth: docs/suas/SUAS-003-sbr.md in the repository.
